facts.text: Lola Sayu was a volcanic and sulfurous planet located within the Lola Sayu system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belderone sector.

evidence.quote: Lola Sayu was a volcanic and sulfurous planet located within the Lola Sayu system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belderone sector.

facts.text: Appearing with a beautiful purple glow from its orbit, the planet had suffered an unknown event that caused its molten core to be exposed, and continued to slowly fall apart for several millennia afterwards, before its discovery by the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: Appearing with a beautiful purple glow from its orbit, the planet had suffered an unknown event that caused its molten core to be exposed, and continued to slowly fall apart for several millennia afterwards, before its discovery by the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: Following its Republic discovery, in 522 BBY, the galactic government and the Jedi Order constructed a maximum-security prison known as the Citadel to hold rogue Jedi.

evidence.quote: Following its Republic discovery, in 522 BBY, the galactic government and the Jedi Order constructed a maximum-security prison known as the Citadel to hold rogue Jedi.

facts.text: Although a Republic world for centuries, Lola Sayu's allegiance eventually shifted after being captured by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars fought between the two factions.

evidence.quote: Although a Republic world for centuries, Lola Sayu's allegiance eventually shifted after being captured by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars fought between the two factions.

facts.text: Taking the Citadel in their efforts, the Separatists placed Phindian Commander Osi Sobeck in charge of the facility and blockaded Lola Sayu with a fleet in orbit, while also turning the Citadel into a nigh-impregnable fortress.

evidence.quote: Taking the Citadel in their efforts, the Separatists placed Phindian Commander Osi Sobeck in charge of the facility and blockaded Lola Sayu with a fleet in orbit, while also turning the Citadel into a nigh-impregnable fortress.

facts.text: After the end of the war, the Citadel was rumored by individuals to have been cursed and haunted.

evidence.quote: After the end of the war, the Citadel was rumored by individuals to have been cursed and haunted.

facts.text: However, an old garrison of Separatist battle droids continued to operate within the facility, led by a malfunctioning droid acting on an adjusted final directive to target all Force-sensitives.

evidence.quote: However, an old garrison of Separatist battle droids continued to operate within the facility, led by a malfunctioning droid acting on an adjusted final directive to target all Force-sensitives.

facts.text: Said directive thereby led to the imprisonment of a Force-sensitive youngling within the Citadel, subsequently resulting in a climactic battle at the facility with a Jedi warrior to free the child.

evidence.quote: Said directive thereby led to the imprisonment of a Force-sensitive youngling within the Citadel, subsequently resulting in a climactic battle at the facility with a Jedi warrior to free the child.

facts.text: Later, by the time of 9 ABY, Lola Sayu fell under the jurisdiction of the New Republic, holding prisoners such as Unga Toba, who was serving a twenty-five year sentence on the planet for unlawfully accessing a computer.

evidence.quote: Later, by the time of 9 ABY, Lola Sayu fell under the jurisdiction of the New Republic, holding prisoners such as Unga Toba, who was serving a twenty-five year sentence on the planet for unlawfully accessing a computer.

facts.text: Orbiting a single star, Lola Sayu was a volcanic, decaying but terrestrial planet located in the northeast section of the galaxy, in the Lola Sayu system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belderone sector.

evidence.quote: Orbiting a single star, Lola Sayu was a volcanic, decaying but terrestrial planet located in the northeast section of the galaxy, in the Lola Sayu system of the Outer Rim Territories' Belderone sector.

facts.text: In its orbit, due to an unknown cataclysmic event that caused Lola Sayu's cracked state, the planet's gravitational field was littered with planetary debris that continuously floated its orbit and made spatial approaches difficult and dangerous.

evidence.quote: In its orbit, due to an unknown cataclysmic event that caused Lola Sayu's cracked state, the planet's gravitational field was littered with planetary debris that continuously floated its orbit and made spatial approaches difficult and dangerous.

facts.text: From its orbit and outer space, Lola Sayu appeared with a beautiful purple glow that was created from the brittle volcanic crust of its northern side.

evidence.quote: From its orbit and outer space, Lola Sayu appeared with a beautiful purple glow that was created from the brittle volcanic crust of its northern side.

facts.text: Meanwhile, on its surface, the planet was dotted with caves, crevasses, hills and mountains, alongside river-like cracks that spanned to where the crust ended at its destroyed southern hemisphere, while also glowing with the heat of the lava from the planet's exposed molten core.

evidence.quote: Meanwhile, on its surface, the planet was dotted with caves, crevasses, hills and mountains, alongside river-like cracks that spanned to where the crust ended at its destroyed southern hemisphere, while also glowing with the heat of the lava from the planet's exposed molten core.

facts.text: However, the surface was also extremely treacherous and unpredictable, with several roads perilously closing in on the edges of lava flows that came from the southern side's vast Sulfur Sea, often leading travelers to labyrinth cave systems or dangerously steep valleys.

evidence.quote: However, the surface was also extremely treacherous and unpredictable, with several roads perilously closing in on the edges of lava flows that came from the southern side's vast Sulfur Sea, often leading travelers to labyrinth cave systems or dangerously steep valleys.

facts.text: In addition to its harsh conditions, water was relatively scarce on Lola Sayu and neither plant or animal life were known to exist on the planet's surface.

evidence.quote: In addition to its harsh conditions, water was relatively scarce on Lola Sayu and neither plant or animal life were known to exist on the planet's surface.

facts.text: Despite the planet's inherent fragility, Lola Sayu was habitable and life-supporting to an extent, holding a breathable, oxygen-mixed yet thin atmosphere on its northern side, that was suitable for species such as humans, Phindian and Togruta.

evidence.quote: Despite the planet's inherent fragility, Lola Sayu was habitable and life-supporting to an extent, holding a breathable, oxygen-mixed yet thin atmosphere on its northern side, that was suitable for species such as humans, Phindian and Togruta.

facts.text: Prior to its discovery by the Galactic Republic, the Outer Rim world known as Lola Sayu was plagued by a cataclysmic event.

evidence.quote: Prior to its discovery by the Galactic Republic, the Outer Rim world known as Lola Sayu was plagued by a cataclysmic event.

facts.text: In its aftermath, nearly the entire southern hemisphere of the planet had disappeared, forming a gravitational belt of planetary debris in its orbit as its surface continued to slowly fall apart over millennia.

evidence.quote: In its aftermath, nearly the entire southern hemisphere of the planet had disappeared, forming a gravitational belt of planetary debris in its orbit as its surface continued to slowly fall apart over millennia.

facts.text: Despite its broken state, though, the planet retained a precarious ability to sustain terrestrial life on its northern side and was eventually discovered by the Republic by the time of 522 BBY, who decided to utilize Lola Sayu's surface for a grim purpose.

evidence.quote: Despite its broken state, though, the planet retained a precarious ability to sustain terrestrial life on its northern side and was eventually discovered by the Republic by the time of 522 BBY, who decided to utilize Lola Sayu's surface for a grim purpose.

facts.text: In 522 BBY, the Republic worked alongside its allies of the Jedi Order to establish an isolated, maximum-security prison that would eventually become known as the infamous Citadel.

evidence.quote: In 522 BBY, the Republic worked alongside its allies of the Jedi Order to establish an isolated, maximum-security prison that would eventually become known as the infamous Citadel.

facts.text: Designed to contain Jedi individuals who had either gone rogue or fallen to the dark side of the Force, the spiring facility was constructed on the north-western side of the planet, along a bridge between two lakes of yellow lava, powered by the geothermal energies that emanated from Lola Sayu.
